summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Limited, an Australian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX public notice dated September 30, 2026, titled 'Appendix 4G and Corporate Governance Statement.' The filing is a routine annual corporate-governance disclosure under ASX Listing Rules 4.7.3 and 4.10.3, confirming the statement is current as of September 22, 2026 and board-approved, with the URL hosted on the company's investor website. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural mechanic is implicated. The equivalent US filing is a routine annual governance/proxy-type disclosure, carrying no deal or event risk.
